Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A jobs report presents a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant offers an alpine-inspired dining experience with traditional Swiss dishes such as cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. The site highlights warm wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Your brief introduction and visible email address make it easy to understand whose site it is and how to contact you. Based on the content available, I think adding a short bio, your interests, and a few examples of your work would help visitors get to know you better.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a personal touch and a clear starting point. Based on the content available, I'd love to see posts about your favorite trails, trip photos, and practical hiking tips—those would make the blog more useful and engaging for readers.
